prompt: Why might this listener cause GUI freezing?
choices: Thread.sleep() is not allowed inside a lambda
label.setText() must be called before Thread.sleep()
Thread.sleep() blocks the EDT for 3 seconds, preventing all GUI updates
addActionListener accepts only anonymous classes, not lambdas
explanation: actionPerformed runs on the EDT. Sleeping there blocks all event processing for 3 seconds — the window becomes unresponsive. Use SwingWorker to run the wait in the background, then update the label on the EDT.
